scope.flow: TrailsRouter public execute/pullAmountAndExecute using delegatecall to Multicall3 aggregate3Value to move router-held funds
scope.environment: EVM smart contract (TrailsRouter with delegated Multicall3)
evidence: Public execute and pullAmountAndExecute allow draining router-held residual funds via delegated Multicall3.

Root cause: `TrailsRouter` is publicly callable and `delegatecall`s Multicall3 aggregate3Value, permitting arbitrary targets and ETH values drawn from `address(this)`. The router can accumulate value via:
- Targets returning ETH/tokens to the router. Thus, any nonzero router-held funds can be exfiltrated by a third party via `execute`.
